A Beautiful Dining Experience ❤️

We had such a wonderful experience at Mediterra! From the moment we arrived, the staff made our whole family feel so welcomed and special. The hospitality was truly exceptional, and everyone was so warm, friendly and attentive.

The food was absolutely beautiful, with every dish making the experience even more memorable. It was so lovely to enjoy delicious food in such a welcoming atmosphere, especially while travelling with our family.

A huge thank you to the amazing team for making us feel so comfortable and looked after. Your kindness and hospitality made our visit extra special. We highly recommend Mediterra to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City and would love to come back again! ❤️

Delicious Bouillabaisse
Aug 2026 • Couples
We ate dinner tonight at Mediterra Restaurant and the food and service exceeded our expectations. We only had one dish - the bouillabaisse - and it was outstandingly delicious. Cheong, the waiter come chef, cooked the meal on the table in front of us. The stock, seafood and rouille were all lovely and the toasted and fresh bread on the side finished the meal off nicely.

If you like seafood then try this version of bouillabaisse where the seafood is incrementally put into the stock to ensure it is not overcooked. Highly recommended!!
